_readme: SEC-UG-NON-INTERFERENCE-PROOF-FOR-EVERY-EXPOSED-FUNCTION-AND-TABLE-20261111 (#8323). Function signatures no call of the proof gets past their checks, for the listed roles: these are NOT proven, and stay listed under open #8359 until each gets a probe in probes.json. Each entry pins, per role, the exact refusals that role gets (SQLSTATE and message, ids and times replaced). The proof fails on an unreached signature and role missing here, on an entry whose roles or refusals change, and on an entry whose function is reached or gone, so this list can only shrink. The notProven list names functions the proof reaches but cannot prove, because their answers need an id masked (volatile.json notProven rules); the run fails if such a function is missing here, and an entry no rule needs any more fails as stale. The blocked list names controller-approved producer defects by signature, record and reason: these calls are explicitly excluded and counted NOT PROVEN in the full installed catalog; they are never normalized into a passing comparison. A blocked signature missing from the catalog fails as stale. Remove an exclusion only after its producer fix passes strict comparison. The untested list names functions the proof reaches on generic arguments but whose object id parameter no neighbour call ever filled, so no neighbour call can fail for them (untestedFunctions in scripts/lib/non-interference.mjs): NOT PROVEN, each with its reason; the run fails on such a function missing here, and on an entry that is no longer untested.
